title: Polish the admin panel on mobile

criteria.text: Requests and Seasons: long team names no longer crush, and Approve/Reject and the season action buttons are fully on screen and reachable at 390, 360 and 320px (before and after pictures)
Teams: all four tabs (Manage Teams, Create Team, Update Logos, Member Approvals) can be reached by touch at 390, 360 and 320px

Timeslots: the chosen block chip is clearly visible and chips are 44px high; the Double Header and Avoid rematches and Dual match mode switches and Mark as final switch have a 44px tap area (tap-offset test)
Scores: team labels show the full name (cut only at the edge), Final shows once, changed status colours are 4.5:1 or better, time-slot header is 44px high
Live corrections filters stack cleanly with 44px selects; League night status text colours are 4.5:1 or better in light and dark
Phone menu drawer targets are 44px high and it still works at 320x568; small items (team and request selects, timeslot list column, score approval row) fixed

No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 390/360/320, existing tests pass (updated only where the changed text or classes are asserted, never weakened), six checks pass, independent review approves the final commit
